info.about: Lollipop Chainsaw is a 2012 action-adventure game developed by Grasshopper Manufacture. A collaboration between game designer Goichi Suda and filmmaker James Gunn, the game was published in Japan by Kadokawa Games and internationally by Warner Bros.
info.trivia: A collaboration between Goichi Suda and James Gunn, it later influenced Gunn when he directed The Suicide Squad (2021).
info.why: It built a cult following, enough that a remaster, Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP, was made at players' request and released in 2024.
